description: This file contains a Smarty plugin defining the {html_checkboxes} function, which generates HTML checkbox input elements based on provided parameters. It includes functions for rendering checkboxes and handling their output, with support for options like 'values', 'checked', 'separator', and 'assign'.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_checkboxes
methods.description: Generates a list of HTML checkbox inputs based on parameters, supporting options like 'values', 'options', 'checked', 'separator', and 'assign'.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_checkboxes_output
methods.description: Creates the HTML for a single checkbox input, including label wrapping and checked state.
